testcase.name: a window finished for good saves once more and only then gives its project's storage back
when the unsaved text cannot be carried over the window keeps its project and says why
a window that died with the process comes back to its project, its file and the text that was typed
a deleted project's drafts are forgotten once its last flush is done
the project of the saved instance state comes first
a single file opened without its folder is known as one, also after the process died
the drafts of a project some window has open are never forgotten
switching to the same project in another place carries the unsaved text along and moves its drafts
a refusal that comes after this window's project was closed reopens that project, never a dead session
once the first window has closed the project, another window opens it with the drafts the first one left
restore happens once, so a new onCreate does not reopen anything
opening a project another window has open keeps this window's own project, and says why
opening another project ends the first, which gives its storage back after its last save
reopening the open project keeps it this window's
a project open in one window is not opened in a second, which says why
a switch to a project another window has open keeps the window's project working, and says why
a main file that is not text fails to open with the failure itself, and nothing crashes
a project whose main file is gone fails with the reason, and storage is not left counting it as open
a new window beside the one that has the last project open starts without a project
the window gaining focus looks at storage, and going to the background writes the drafts
after a switch to the same project in another place each file opens where it was left
an included file that is not text is a load failure of that file, and the project opens
opening the open project again in the same window waits for its last drafts
a project that cannot be reached says which unsaved texts are kept for when it can
a main file deleted while the app was dead opens with its unsaved text
closing the project gives its storage back and the next start opens nothing
